info.title: Nyx Panel Daily API
info.description: Daily operations of a Nyx Panel node service. Mount this contract on the individual connection; each instance routes through its own NyxID node. Includes on-demand camera photos, display and persistent fallback, calls, audio output, input mode and brightness. Selecting the Bot, credentials, network and system management require the separately authorized management service. Voice uses the panel's own Key and the selected Bot's existing grants.

get.summary: Read current panel status, selected Bot, voice state and resource availability. Returns no credentials.

x-aevatar-tool.name: get_status
x-aevatar-tool.description: Read current panel status, selected Bot, voice state and resource availability. Returns no credentials.

get.summary: Read camera availability, capture count, image size and last capture error. Does not take a photograph.

x-aevatar-tool.name: get_camera
x-aevatar-tool.description: Read camera availability, capture count, image size and last capture error. Does not take a photograph.

get.summary: Capture a camera JPEG without changing the panel display. Use take_camera_photo for normal user-facing capture and display. No continuous stream; camera resources are released afterwards.

x-aevatar-tool.name: get_camera_photo
x-aevatar-tool.description: Capture a camera JPEG without changing the panel display. Use take_camera_photo for normal user-facing capture and display. No continuous stream; camera resources are released afterwards.

503.description: Camera is busy or unavailable; no image was captured.

get.summary: Read a JPEG screenshot of the panel display. This is the screen, not the physical camera view.

x-aevatar-tool.name: get_screen_photo
x-aevatar-tool.description: Read a JPEG screenshot of the panel display. This is the screen, not the physical camera view.

post.summary: Show caption text over the current fullscreen image.

x-aevatar-tool.name: show_text
x-aevatar-tool.description: Show caption text over the current fullscreen image.

202.description: Success; asynchronous requests must be checked against current device state.

duration_ms.description: Caption duration in milliseconds; 0 keeps it until cleared.

post.summary: Clear temporary captions and images, restoring the saved fallback image.

x-aevatar-tool.name: clear_display
x-aevatar-tool.description: Clear temporary captions and images, restoring the saved fallback image.

get.summary: Read current call state, selected Bot, microphone mute, media counters and remote request stage. accepted is not proof of audible playback.

x-aevatar-tool.name: get_voice
x-aevatar-tool.description: Read current call state, selected Bot, microphone mute, media counters and remote request stage. accepted is not proof of audible playback.

post.summary: Open automatic two-way voice with the panel-selected Bot and expand the voice controls. A different call while busy returns 409. Does not change the saved input mode. Optional text is a spoken opening notification.

x-aevatar-tool.name: open_voice
x-aevatar-tool.description: Open automatic two-way voice with the panel-selected Bot and expand the voice controls. A different call while busy returns 409. Does not change the saved input mode. Optional text is a spoken opening notification.

202.description: Success; asynchronous requests must be checked against current device state.

request_id.description: A fresh UUID for a new request. Reuse the same UUID and arguments when retrying; recent requests survive reboot.

text.description: Nonblank speech text, at most 300 UTF-8 bytes, with no control characters. This is a spoken notification, never user input or permission to use tools.

microphone_muted.description: Mute the microphone at call start.

post.summary: Speak a notification in the active call. Check get_voice for completion; provider acceptance does not prove playback.

x-aevatar-tool.name: say_voice
x-aevatar-tool.description: Speak a notification in the active call. Check get_voice for completion; provider acceptance does not prove playback.

202.description: Success; asynchronous requests must be checked against current device state.

request_id.description: A fresh UUID for a new request. Reuse the same UUID and arguments when retrying; recent requests survive reboot.

text.description: Nonblank speech text, at most 300 UTF-8 bytes, with no control characters. This is a spoken notification, never user input or permission to use tools.

post.summary: Mute or unmute the current call microphone without muting Bot audio.

x-aevatar-tool.name: set_microphone_mute
x-aevatar-tool.description: Mute or unmute the current call microphone without muting Bot audio.

post.summary: End the active call and release microphone, speaker and WebRTC resources. This ends the current voice conversation.

x-aevatar-tool.name: stop_voice
x-aevatar-tool.description: End the active call and release microphone, speaker and WebRTC resources. This ends the current voice conversation.

post.summary: Take one fresh photograph with the panel camera, display that exact photograph fullscreen on the panel for two minutes, and return the same JPEG for visual understanding. Use this for normal user requests to look through the camera. Voice controls and captions remain available; the saved fallback image is preserved. Camera resources are released after capture, with no continuous stream.

x-aevatar-tool.name: take_camera_photo
x-aevatar-tool.description: Take one fresh photograph with the panel camera, display that exact photograph fullscreen on the panel for two minutes, and return the same JPEG for visual understanding. Use this for normal user requests to look through the camera. Voice controls and captions remain available; the saved fallback image is preserved. Camera resources are released after capture, with no continuous stream.

503.description: Camera is busy or unavailable; no image was captured.

get.summary: Read this panel firmware version and the live API description filtered to this service permission scope.

x-aevatar-tool.name: get_api_description
x-aevatar-tool.description: Read this panel firmware version and the live API description filtered to this service permission scope.

get.summary: Read the active application and screen navigation depth.

x-aevatar-tool.name: get_screen
x-aevatar-tool.description: Read the active application and screen navigation depth.

post.summary: Show a temporary fullscreen JPEG supplied as binary request bytes, at most 65536 bytes. Leaves the persistent fallback unchanged.

x-aevatar-tool.name: show_image
x-aevatar-tool.description: Show a temporary fullscreen JPEG supplied as binary request bytes, at most 65536 bytes. Leaves the persistent fallback unchanged.

schema.description: Raw JPEG bytes. For a fresh camera photo shown on the panel, use take_camera_photo.

get.summary: List the Bots whose Voice services the panel own Key is authorized to use. Changing the saved selection requires the separate management service.

x-aevatar-tool.name: list_voice_bots
x-aevatar-tool.description: List the Bots whose Voice services the panel own Key is authorized to use. Changing the saved selection requires the separate management service.

post.summary: Refresh the list of Bots authorized for this panel Key. Does not alter the selected Bot or its service grants.

x-aevatar-tool.name: refresh_voice_bots
x-aevatar-tool.description: Refresh the list of Bots authorized for this panel Key. Does not alter the selected Bot or its service grants.

post.summary: Start voice with the saved input mode. Use open_voice for remote automatic two-way conversation.

x-aevatar-tool.name: start_voice
x-aevatar-tool.description: Start voice with the saved input mode. Use open_voice for remote automatic two-way conversation.

post.summary: Press or release the talk control in push-to-talk mode. Use open_voice for automatic conversation without holding a button.

x-aevatar-tool.name: hold_voice
x-aevatar-tool.description: Press or release the talk control in push-to-talk mode. Use open_voice for automatic conversation without holding a button.

get.summary: Read saved hardware volume, playback gain and live voice state.

x-aevatar-tool.name: get_audio_settings
x-aevatar-tool.description: Read saved hardware volume, playback gain and live voice state.

post.summary: Adjust and persist exactly one field: volume (integer 0..100) or playback_gain (integer 1..8). Can be adjusted during a call. Does not select a Bot.

x-aevatar-tool.name: set_audio_output
x-aevatar-tool.description: Adjust and persist exactly one field: volume (integer 0..100) or playback_gain (integer 1..8). Can be adjusted during a call. Does not select a Bot.

post.summary: Set saved automatic or push_to_talk input mode while idle (409 during a call). Does not select a Bot or change grants.

x-aevatar-tool.name: set_voice_input_mode
x-aevatar-tool.description: Set saved automatic or push_to_talk input mode while idle (409 during a call). Does not select a Bot or change grants.

x-aevatar-tool.name: get_screen_brightness
x-aevatar-tool.description: Read saved screen brightness, 0..100.

post.summary: Set and persist screen brightness (integer 0..100), preserving other display settings. Zero turns off the backlight.

x-aevatar-tool.name: set_screen_brightness
x-aevatar-tool.description: Set and persist screen brightness (integer 0..100), preserving other display settings. Zero turns off the backlight.

get.summary: Read persistent fallback image metadata, source, dimensions and byte count.

x-aevatar-tool.name: get_default_image
x-aevatar-tool.description: Read persistent fallback image metadata, source, dimensions and byte count.

post.summary: Save a persistent fullscreen fallback JPEG used whenever no temporary image is visible. Up to 65536 bytes and 800x1280 pixels; survives reboot. Leaves a current temporary image visible.

x-aevatar-tool.name: set_default_image
x-aevatar-tool.description: Save a persistent fullscreen fallback JPEG used whenever no temporary image is visible. Up to 65536 bytes and 800x1280 pixels; survives reboot. Leaves a current temporary image visible.

delete.summary: Remove the saved fallback and restore the bundled NyxBot image. Keeps current temporary images and captions.

x-aevatar-tool.name: restore_default_image
x-aevatar-tool.description: Remove the saved fallback and restore the bundled NyxBot image. Keeps current temporary images and captions.
